_comment: Live probe against designated test company 6789 on 2026-08-26, resolving
project-status T-05/T-06/T-20: how Shopify shipping and discounts can be
represented on a MetaKocka sales order.
Two probe documents were created and both deleted (opr_code 0). Amounts are
gross (price_with_tax) with tax_factor 0.22 throughout; sum_all is gross.

shipping.mechanism: an extra product line at a positive price
shipping.conclusion: An extra line adds to sum_all exactly. Shipping is representable as a line against a merchant-supplied product code.

discountMechanisms.evidence: a line of 200.00 with discount "10" produced sum_all 180 (a 10 per cent cut). An absolute 10.00 would have produced 190.
discountMechanisms.rejects: "10%" is refused: opr_code 2, 'Paramether discount must be valid number or numbers separate by semicolon (for example : 10;20)'. The semicolon form is a chain of percentages.
discountMechanisms.verdict: Not used. Shopify supplies absolute per-line discount amounts, and converting an amount into a percentage invents rounding this app has no authority to invent.

discountMechanisms.semantics: ABSOLUTE AMOUNT in the document currency
discountMechanisms.evidence: goods 200.00 with discount_value "10" produced sum_all 190, not 180. With goods 200.00 plus a 5.00 line, discount_value "10" produced 195, not 184.5 - so it is subtracted from the document total rather than applied per line.
discountMechanisms.rejects: "10%" is refused: opr_code 6, 'Not valid number for discount_value'.
discountMechanisms.verdict: CHOSEN. Absolute is exactly what Shopify supplies, so nothing is converted and no rounding is invented.

discountMechanisms.evidence: goods 200.00 + line 5.00 + line -10.00 produced 195; with -10.37 it produced 194.63.
discountMechanisms.verdict: Works, and deliberately not used: it would put a negative-priced stock article on the document and move inventory for goods that do not exist. discount_value is native and has no such side effect.

fullShape.note: The brief's worked example. Also reproducible as goods 100.00 + shipping line 5.00 + discount_value 10.00, which is the combination this app implements.
